text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x) ::: x downloads a show.
Share(x, y) ::: x shares a show with y.
NetflixShow(x) ::: x is a Netflix show.
Karen(x) ::: x is Karen.
BlackMirror ::: the show Black Mirror.
Premises:
∀x (Popular(x) ∧ NetflixShow(x)) → BingeWatch(x, Karen) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen)) ↔ (Download(x)) ::: Karen will download a show if and only if she binge-watches it.
¬Download(BlackMirror) ::: Karen does not download Black Mirror.
BlackMirror ::: the show Black Mirror.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen)) → Share(x, Lisa) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.
Conclusion:
Share("Stranger Things", Lisa) ::: Karen will share "Stranger Things" with Lisa.
